home.title: Amrithakala Creations
home.description: Amrithakala Creations, the team behind the music album "Thulasikkathir Nulliyeduthu" for Malayalis worldwide, is a cultural platform where tradition meets modernity. From the historical drama "Shivaneriyile Simhagarjjanam", ritual art forms like Sopana Sangeetham and Kathakali, to Chenda Melam ensembles that elevate celebrations, musical concerts, fusion music, and more — Amrithakala Creations brings a diverse array of performances to your doorstep. The creative brilliance of art, now closer to you!

bookings.screenshotHint: Upload the screenshot after making the payment
bookings.termsCheckbox: I have carefully read, clearly understood, and fully accept all the terms and conditions given below.
bookings.term1: 40000 W electricity must be available for the success of the drama.
bookings.term2: The size and strength of the stage must not be compromised.
bookings.term3: The stage must be vacated three hours before the performance time.
bookings.term4: The remaining amount after advance must be handed over to the drama committee secretary before the drama begins, and a receipt must be obtained.
bookings.term5: If the booked drama needs to be postponed or cancelled at the booker's request, the agreement must be personally presented to the committee secretary 15 days before the performance date. Cancellation or postponement through registered letter, phone, or telegram is not possible.
bookings.term6: The advance amount will not be refunded. Any loss incurred by the committee must be paid immediately.
bookings.term7: The jurisdiction for all legal proceedings related to this will be Thiruvalla.
